tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDERS CAN TAKE PART IN THE TENDER BY ACCEPTING THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS STATED IN THE TENDER BID DOCUMENT.
ALL TERMS, NORMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER MENTIONED IN THE TENDER BID DOCUMENT.
The material offered for supply must be of the most recent series incorporating the latest improvements in compositions.
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies with satisfactory certification.
The materials supplied must be of ISI standards
If the supplier is found default in supplying the good quality of material his tender will be terminated without any notice
The supplier must not take any steps or ask information which effects the transparency of the tender.
The instruments should be supplied with warranty cards along with user manuals
The Bidders should quote the items rates including of all taxes.
Bidders should submit the items samples within last date of KPPP procurement submission of documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have ISO and BIS licence obtained from producer
The bidder must submit Satisfactory certificate/ Declaration forms the department /Govt./Semi govt. institutefor the year 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26.
The bidder must have Audit reports for the year 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26.
The distributor/ supplier should have experience in supplying the materials to govt / semi govt departments/ institutes in last three years (for the year 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26
The bidder must have Firm Licenceobtained from the department.
The bidder must submit IT returns for the year 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26.
The bidder must have GST certificate
The bidder must submit Turnover of 3 years yearly turnover should be atleast twice of the ECV (Bid Capacity after necessary Factoring) and turn over must be from the supply of FTK and H2S vials only.
The bidder/Manufacturer must have ISO 9001:2015 Certificate
The Bidder should have associated with NABL Laboratory for testing purpose.
The Bidder/manufacturer should have vendor assessed report for FTK & bacteriological vials from QCI (Quality Council of India)
Bidder/Manufacturer MUST submit the 1qty of FTK and 10 qty of Bacteriological vials as Mentioned in Sample Submission date, FAILING WHICH RESULTS IN REJECTION OF EVALUTION.
ALL ESSENTIAL AND TECHNICALLY REQUIRED DOCUMENTS SHOULD BE UPLOADED AS PER MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT.
